title: WendIcon
description: Renders a single icon from the @devastudios/icons set as inline SVG.

name.description: Name of the icon to render, matching an entry in @devastudios/icons' manifest (e.g. "add", "arrow-right").

size.description: Icon size, as a CSS length (applied to both width and height).

color.description: Icon fill color, as a CSS color.
